verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover each part of the story. Python editor scripting automates asset tasks (e.g. LOD generation), places and lays out Actors in Levels, builds custom asset import pipelines and drives the editor from user-built UIs. Plugins explicitly extend editor capabilities, and the reflection-metadata specifiers, the generated Python API reference with IDE autocomplete stubs, and the Remote Control API (call any BlueprintCallable function) round this out. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of editor tooling in practice, and the Python API reference is still marked Experimental.
